question: What does the CONCATENATE function do in Microsoft Excel?

options.text: Combines text from multiple cells into one cell
Finds the average of a range of cells

solution:
The correct answer is __**Combines text from multiple cells into one cell**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Combines text from multiple cells into one cell** is the primary function of the CONCATENATE function in Microsoft Excel.
 
• It is used to join several text strings into one string.
